elements.title: FHE-friendly Architecture Redesign

figure.caption: Parallel adapter integration with transformer blocks

bullets: Approximates Softmax, GELU, and LayerNorm using low-degree polynomial operations
Uses Taylor series for exponentials and Goldschmidt’s algorithm for division
Parallel adapters enable local training without backpropagation through the backbone

builds.audio_segment: BlindFed replaces non-linearities like Softmax and LayerNorm with polynomial approximations
using Taylor series and Goldschmidt’s algorithm.
A key innovation is the parallel adapter design shown here.

This structure allows clients to update the model using intermediate representations received from the server, completely bypassing the need for backpropagation through the massive, encrypted backbone.
